Quantum 1.23.0 was certified on 2026-08-30. It pins **nucleus v1.20.1**, **quark v1.7.0** and **orbit v1.8.10**, with 6 sibling modules.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.22.0: nucleus goes from v1.17.0 to v1.20.1 (minor), quark goes from v1.6.1 to v1.7.0 (minor) and orbit goes from v1.8.6 to v1.8.10 (patch). 5 sibling modules change version.
